column1: # One tool per line, fields separated by a tab. Read by tools/ToolSpec.kt and
# by scripts/check-tools.sh, so the app and CI can never disagree.
# No version here. The latest one is read from the publisher's index at
# the moment the user asks, so a new release needs no new GutapK.
# source       google-repo: Google's SDK repository XML, index is its URL,
#              github: index is the repository page, package is the pattern
#              of the release asset name, entry is the stable name the
#              asset is copied to. execDir - for a single jar.
